associations.rationale: The formal type directly states that every simple symmetric-group-algebra module is linearly equivalent to a Specht module for some partition, giving the exhaustion assertion.
The formal type proves that Specht modules attached to distinct partitions are not linearly equivalent; this sharpens the classification but is not itself the source's exhaustion assertion.

The formal type states that every partition-indexed Specht module is simple, which supplies one direction needed for the section-level classification but does not itself state that all irreducible representations are described by Specht modules.
